name: BRIGHT-Pro
intro: BRIGHT-Pro 是面向推理密集型检索的专家标注基准。它在 BRIGHT 的 StackExchange 子集上，把 739 个查询分解为带权重的推理方面，并在 526,319 篇统一语料中标注方面级证据；评测同时覆盖静态检索和固定 175 查询的 agentic search。
org: Yale University, National University of Singapore, NYU Shanghai
build_method: 领域专家方面分解与加权, 原正例复核, 网页证据扩充, 双人独立复核
metric: alpha-nDCG@k, Weighted Aspect Recall, NDCG, Recall, Aspect Coverage, Overall Quality, AER
task_type: 检索, Agent搜索, 证据综合
eval_feature: 方面多样性感知的静态检索, 固定轮次与自适应停止的Agentic search, 引用证据综合
scale: 739个查询, 7个领域, 526,319篇统一语料; 175查询agentic子集
build_method_en: Field-expert aspect decomposition and weighting, original-positive re-audit, web evidence expansion, independent second review
eval_feature_en: Aspect-diversity-aware static retrieval, fixed-round and adaptive-stop agentic search, citation-grounded synthesis
intro_en: BRIGHT-Pro is an expert-annotated benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Built from the BRIGHT StackExchange subset, it decomposes 739 queries into weighted reasoning aspects and annotates aspect-level evidence in a unified corpus of 526,319 documents; evaluation covers static retrieval and agentic search on a fixed 175-query subset.
scale_en: 739 queries, 7 domains, 526,319-document unified corpus; 175-query agentic subset
metric_en: alpha-nDCG@k, Weighted Aspect Recall, NDCG, Recall, Aspect Coverage, Overall Quality, AER

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.04018v1 §§3.1–3.4, §§4.1–4.3, and Appendices D and F. Operational evidence is official repo 5df9e9baf5a0525a2b962d73f213c9dee63c5f3e and initial HF dataset revision dbdc22babbef310210e267b99249e7cec86d5edf; code locators include agentic_sample_ids.json, retrieval/metrics.py, retrieval/evaluation/alpha-ndcg-evaluation.py, agentic_retrieval/scripts_evaluation/judge.py, and the fixed/adaptive search-agent entry points. The paper's annotation protocol uses Likert 1–5 then normalized weights, while all 2,763 aspect rows in the pinned HF release use raw values {1, 2, 3}; the official sources do not specify a mapping, so the diagram preserves this paper-versus-release boundary. Seven BRIGHT StackExchange domains yield 739 queries, 526,319 corpus documents, 2,763 aspects, and 5,272 gold passages after field-expert decomposition, positive re-audit, FireCrawl-assisted evidence collection, iterative refinement, and same-field second review. Static evaluation uses alpha-nDCG with alpha 0.5 and weighted A-Recall. Agentic evaluation fixes 175 queries (25 per domain, seed 42), top-5 results per round, GPT-5-mini or Qwen3.5 agents, fixed R in {1,2,3} or adaptive stopping, GPT-5 aspect and overall judging, and AER; Appendix D validates GPT-5 reference answers against 40 human-written samples.
